g.text: TARGET DESIGN: extend the existing blocking relay
existing stdin framing / handle / send / reply
native executable and per-OS argument array
native ACP exchange inside blocking call
access mode derived from explicit tool
final answer/error within existing relay policies
grokExecutable / clineExecutable : optional absolute native path
owned temp directory / exclusive prompt file
Public input remains prompt; output remains MCP text/error.
New symbol names are design, not implemented modules.
No new public job lifecycle or permission API.
Native bindings must be qualified before production changes.
Windows fixed helper / owned path only
Gray/existing: retained Claude path and framing.
Modified: TOOLS dispatch only as needed for new agents.
